entry.description: give `RegexToMatch` matching a deadline in `StringMatchFilter` and the filters deriving from it, `PropertyFilter`, `MdcFilter` and `NdcFilter`. The pattern was matched with `Regex.InfiniteMatchTimeout` while the appender lock was held, so a pattern that backtracks could stall everything logging through the appender on some inputs. Matching now stops after `MatchTimeoutMillis`, 1000 by default, and an abandoned match is reported once and leaves the event to the rest of the filter chain; 0 restores unbounded matching. The pattern comes from configuration and is trusted, so this is hardening rather than a vulnerability fix (audit 1231d72-f013)
